title: Decoupling scales via localized subspace iteration and temporal splitting for multiscale parabolic equations
summary: Simulating diffusion in heterogeneous media presents a significant computational challenge, as resolving microscopic physical scales traditionally demands excessively fine computational grids. To overcome this barrier, we extend the Localized Subspace Iteration (LSI) framework to multiscale parabolic equations. The proposed method constructs optimal, low-dimensional trial spaces by iteratively approximating the dominant eigenspaces of local inverse operators via Localized Standard Subspace Iteration (LSSI) or Localized Krylov Subspace Iteration (LKSI).
